verdict.rationale: Rive documents an in-editor AI agent, MCP tools for repetitive tasks, and a CLI that agents can drive. All of these are on-demand, user- or agent-invoked actions, not automations that run autonomously in the background on a schedule or trigger. No evidence shows background jobs, recurring schedules, or event-triggered automations, so these are only adjacent building blocks and the applicable axis is unmet.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
